source.title: How to Use Apple Music Sing
source.versionLimit: Official tutorial published January 2023; iPhone14Pro-style editorial screen. Exact OS/app build unknown.

method.description: Independent per-physical-line normalized high-pass template match at every original source frame. Crop geometry is measured in displayed video pixels, not iPhone logical points. Fixed template widths/heights locate the glyph patch; they are not remeasured dynamic ink bounds.
method.yKind: padded glyph-template top; bottom_proxy is not an actual typographic baseline
method.subpixel: Quadratic peak-position estimate inside an observed frame, never a temporal in-between frame
method.spatialUncertainty: Conservative +/-2px B/C and early A; +/-3px soft D. These are engineering uncertainty bounds, not statistical confidence intervals. Compression, defocus, and word-highlight intensity can bias shape matching.
method.temporalUncertainty: 33.3667ms native-frame interval. Event onset is bracketed between native samples; no evidence for120Hz or sub-frame timing.
method.manualValidation: Listed keyframes inspected, complete track continuity reviewed; manual_valid=null means not individually inspected, not invalid. Alternate templates were seeded after motion and tracked backward.
method.split: Even source frames designated calibration; odd source frames designated temporal holdout. Fit models only on calibration. This is within-sequence temporal holdout, not an independent device/clip test.
method.copyright: All exported frames are geometry only; no song text, artwork, audio, or source image pixels.
